title: 🔥 BREAKING FREE: HOW TO RECEIVE AND MINISTER DELIVERANCE BIBLICALLY!
paragraphs:
🔥 BREAKING FREE: HOW TO RECEIVE AND MINISTER DELIVERANCE BIBLICALLY!
💭 READER QUESTION:
"Brother John, I have heard about deliverance, but I don’t fully understand it. Is deliverance still for today? How do we receive it, and can Christians perform it?"

🔥 EXCELLENT QUESTION! Many believers are unaware of the power of deliverance and its importance in the Christian walk. Some even believe deliverance ended with the apostles, but the Bible shows that Jesus commanded His followers to continue this work!

📖 Mark 16:17 (KJV)
"And these signs shall follow them that believe; In my name shall they cast out devils."
🚨 WHAT IS DELIVERANCE?

✔️ Deliverance is NOT just about casting out demons—it’s about breaking every chain of bondage!
✔️ Deliverance is NOT optional—it is part of spiritual warfare!
✔️ Deliverance is NOT for a select few—it is for ALL believers who walk in Jesus’ authority!
🔥 TRUE DELIVERANCE IS ABOUT FREEDOM FROM SATAN’S POWER!
💡 QUESTION: Do you believe that Jesus still delivers people today, or have you been deceived into thinking it no longer happens?
IS DELIVERANCE FOR TODAY? WHAT DOES THE BIBLE SAY?

💭 READER QUESTION:
"Brother John, some people say that deliverance was only for the time of Jesus and the apostles. Is that true? Does the Bible really say deliverance is for today?"

🔥 EXCELLENT QUESTION! Many churches today ignore or deny deliverance, claiming it was only for the early church. But the Bible clearly shows that deliverance is for all believers until the return of Christ!

📖 Hebrews 13:8 (KJV)
"Jesus Christ the same yesterday, and today, and forever."
🚨 WHY IS DELIVERANCE STILL FOR TODAY?

✔️ 1️⃣ Jesus commanded His followers to cast out demons!
📖 Mark 16:17 (KJV) – "And these signs shall follow them that believe; In my name shall they cast out devils."

✔️ 2️⃣ The apostles and early church continued deliverance after Jesus ascended!
📖 Acts 8:7 (KJV) – "For unclean spirits, crying with loud voice, came out of many that were possessed."

✔️ 3️⃣ Spiritual warfare did not end with the early church—we are still in battle today!
📖 Ephesians 6:12 (KJV) – "For we wrestle not against flesh and blood, but against principalities, against powers, against the rulers of the darkness of this world."

✔️ 4️⃣ Satan still attacks believers today—so deliverance is still necessary!
📖 1 Peter 5:8 (KJV) – "Be sober, be vigilant; because your adversary the devil, as a roaring lion, walketh about, seeking whom he may devour."
🔥 DELIVERANCE IS NOT A PAST EVENT—IT IS AN ONGOING WAR AGAINST DARKNESS!

📖 Luke 10:19 (KJV)
"Behold, I give unto you power to tread on serpents and scorpions, and over all the power of the enemy: and nothing shall by any means hurt you."
🚨 WHAT DOES THIS MEAN FOR US?

✔️ If deliverance was only for the apostles, why did Jesus give ALL believers authority?
✔️ If demons still attack people today, why wouldn’t we still need deliverance?
✔️ If we ignore deliverance, we are ignoring part of Jesus’ mission!
🔥 THE CHURCH MUST WAKE UP—DELIVERANCE IS A COMMAND, NOT AN OPTION!
💡 QUESTION: Do you believe that deliverance is for today, or have you been misled into thinking it ended with the early church?
HOW DO PEOPLE BECOME BOUND BY DEMONS AND NEED DELIVERANCE?

💭 READER QUESTION:
"Brother John, how do people end up needing deliverance? Can a Christian be affected by demons?"

🔥 EXCELLENT QUESTION! Many people believe that demons only affect unbelievers, but even Christians can come under demonic attack if they open doors to the enemy. The Bible warns us to be vigilant because Satan is always seeking to attack!

📖 Ephesians 4:27 (KJV)
"Neither give place to the devil."
🚨 HOW DO PEOPLE OPEN DOORS TO DEMONIC OPPRESSION?

✔️ 1️⃣ Practicing Occult Activities – Witchcraft, horoscopes, psychics, and New Age practices invite demons.
📖 Deuteronomy 18:10-12 (KJV) – "There shall not be found among you any one that maketh his son or his daughter to pass through the fire, or that useth divination, or an observer of times, or an enchanter, or a witch… For all that do these things are an abomination unto the Lord."

✔️ 2️⃣ Unrepented Sin and Addiction – Pornography, drugs, and habitual sin open doors to demonic bondage.
📖 John 8:34 (KJV) – "Whosoever committeth sin is the servant of sin."

✔️ 3️⃣ Trauma and Abuse – Emotional wounds can give demons access to torment people with fear and depression.
📖 Isaiah 61:1 (KJV) – "He hath sent me to bind up the brokenhearted, to proclaim liberty to the captives."

✔️ 4️⃣ Generational Curses – Family sins can allow demons to operate through bloodlines.
📖 Exodus 20:5 (KJV) – "Visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children unto the third and fourth generation."

✔️ 5️⃣ Idolatry and False Religion – Worshiping idols or following false doctrines invites deception.
📖 1 Corinthians 10:20 (KJV) – "The things which the Gentiles sacrifice, they sacrifice to devils, and not to God."
🔥 DEMONIC BONDAGE HAPPENS WHEN WE OPEN DOORS—BUT JESUS CAME TO SET US FREE!

📖 John 8:36 (KJV)
"If the Son therefore shall make you free, ye shall be free indeed."
🚨 WHAT DOES THIS MEAN FOR US?

✔️ If you have ever engaged in these things, you need deliverance!
✔️ If you struggle with persistent sin, you may be under demonic oppression!
✔️ If you have fear, torment, or addictions, Jesus wants to set you free!
🔥 YOU CANNOT FIGHT SPIRITUAL BATTLES WITH PHYSICAL STRENGTH—YOU NEED THE POWER OF JESUS!
💡 QUESTION: Have you unknowingly opened doors to the enemy? Are you truly walking in freedom?
HOW DO YOU RECEIVE DELIVERANCE? STEP-BY-STEP FREEDOM THROUGH CHRIST!

💭 READER QUESTION:
"Brother John, if someone realizes they need deliverance, what should they do? How can they be set free from demonic oppression?"

🔥 EXCELLENT QUESTION! Deliverance is not about magic words—it is about surrendering to Jesus and using His authority to break demonic strongholds. The enemy has no power over a believer who is fully submitted to Christ!

📖 James 4:7 (KJV)
"Submit yourselves therefore to God. Resist the devil, and he will flee from you."
🚨 STEP-BY-STEP PROCESS FOR DELIVERANCE:

✔️ 1️⃣ FULLY SURRENDER TO JESUS! – Deliverance is only possible through Christ. You must be truly saved!
📖 Acts 4:12 (KJV) – "Neither is there salvation in any other: for there is none other name under heaven given among men, whereby we must be saved."

✔️ 2️⃣ CONFESS AND REPENT OF ALL SINS! – You cannot cast out demons while holding onto sin!
📖 1 John 1:9 (KJV) – "If we confess our sins, he is faithful and just to forgive us our sins."

✔️ 3️⃣ BREAK ALL DEMONIC AGREEMENTS! – Renounce every sin, curse, or occult practice you have participated in.
📖 2 Corinthians 6:14-15 (KJV) – "What communion hath light with darkness? And what concord hath Christ with Belial?"

✔️ 4️⃣ CAST OUT DEMONS IN THE NAME OF JESUS! – Use your authority in Christ to command unclean spirits to leave.
📖 Luke 10:19 (KJV) – "Behold, I give unto you power to tread on serpents and scorpions, and over all the power of the enemy."

✔️ 5️⃣ FILL YOURSELF WITH THE HOLY SPIRIT! – If you do not fill the empty space, demons can return!
📖 Matthew 12:43-45 (KJV) – "Then goeth he, and taketh with himself seven other spirits more wicked than himself."

✔️ 6️⃣ WALK IN HOLINESS AND PRAYER! – Deliverance is not just about being set free—it’s about staying free!
📖 Galatians 5:16 (KJV) – "This I say then, Walk in the Spirit, and ye shall not fulfil the lust of the flesh."
🔥 WHEN YOU FOLLOW THESE STEPS, SATAN LOSES HIS HOLD OVER YOU!

📖 John 8:32 (KJV)
"And ye shall know the truth, and the truth shall make you free."
🚨 WHAT DOES THIS MEAN FOR US?

✔️ Deliverance is for ALL believers—it is part of your inheritance in Christ!
✔️ You have authority over demons—but only if you walk in obedience!
✔️ Jesus wants you free—don’t stay in bondage any longer!
🔥 JESUS CAME TO DESTROY THE WORKS OF THE DEVIL—IT’S TIME TO WALK IN FREEDOM!
💡 QUESTION: Are you ready to break free from every chain and walk in complete deliverance?
HOW CAN BELIEVERS PERFORM DELIVERANCE FOR OTHERS?

💭 READER QUESTION:
"Brother John, can any believer cast out demons, or is deliverance only for pastors and ministers? How do we help others break free?"
🔥 EXCELLENT QUESTION! Many think deliverance is only for a select few, but Jesus gave ALL believers authority over demons. The power is not in us—it is in the name of Jesus!

📖 Mark 16:17 (KJV)
"And these signs shall follow them that believe; In my name shall they cast out devils."
🚨 WHO CAN PERFORM DELIVERANCE?

✔️ ANY TRUE BELIEVER! – Deliverance is for all disciples of Jesus, not just church leaders.
📖 Luke 10:19 (KJV) – "Behold, I give unto you power to tread on serpents and scorpions, and over all the power of the enemy."

✔️ THOSE WALKING IN HOLINESS! – You cannot cast out demons if you are living in sin!
📖 Acts 19:15 (KJV) – "And the evil spirit answered and said, Jesus I know, and Paul I know; but who are ye?"

✔️ THOSE FILLED WITH THE HOLY SPIRIT! – Deliverance requires spiritual power, not human strength.
📖 Acts 1:8 (KJV) – "But ye shall receive power, after that the Holy Ghost is come upon you."
🚨 STEP-BY-STEP PROCESS TO DELIVER OTHERS:

✔️ 1️⃣ DISCERN THE NEED FOR DELIVERANCE! – Not every issue is demonic, but some strongholds require casting out.
📖 1 Corinthians 12:10 (KJV) – "To another discerning of spirits."

✔️ 2️⃣ LEAD THE PERSON TO REPENTANCE! – Deliverance is ineffective without true repentance.
📖 James 4:7 (KJV) – "Submit yourselves therefore to God. Resist the devil, and he will flee from you."

✔️ 3️⃣ BREAK CURSES AND RENOUNCE LEGAL RIGHTS! – The enemy must have no claim over the person’s life.
📖 Galatians 3:13 (KJV) – "Christ hath redeemed us from the curse of the law."

✔️ 4️⃣ COMMAND THE DEMONS TO LEAVE IN JESUS’ NAME! – Speak with authority and cast them out!
📖 Matthew 10:1 (KJV) – "And when he had called unto him his twelve disciples, he gave them power against unclean spirits, to cast them out."

✔️ 5️⃣ PRAY FOR THE INFILLING OF THE HOLY SPIRIT! – The person must be filled with God’s presence to remain free.
📖 Ephesians 5:18 (KJV) – "Be filled with the Spirit."

✔️ 6️⃣ TEACH THEM TO WALK IN FREEDOM! – Help them stay in prayer, the Word, and holiness.
📖 John 8:36 (KJV) – "If the Son therefore shall make you free, ye shall be free indeed."
🔥 DELIVERANCE IS NOT ABOUT SHOUTING LOUDER—IT’S ABOUT USING JESUS’ AUTHORITY!
🚨 WHAT DOES THIS MEAN FOR US?

✔️ If you are a true believer, you have authority to set captives free!
✔️ Deliverance is not about fear—it is about enforcing Jesus’ victory!
✔️ We must train more Christians to walk in power and boldness!
🔥 THE DEVIL WANTS THE CHURCH TO BE SILENT ABOUT DELIVERANCE—BUT WE MUST RISE UP!
💡 QUESTION: Are you willing to step out in faith and help others experience freedom in Christ?
FINAL CHALLENGE – WILL YOU WALK IN DELIVERANCE AND HELP SET CAPTIVES FREE?

💭 THE MOMENT OF DECISION IS HERE!
Now that you understand the power of deliverance, the question is: Will you step into your God-given authority and help others break free from the chains of the enemy?

📖 Isaiah 61:1 (KJV)
"The Spirit of the Lord God is upon me; because the Lord hath anointed me to preach good tidings unto the meek; he hath sent me to bind up the brokenhearted, to proclaim liberty to the captives, and the opening of the prison to them that are bound."
🚨 WHAT WILL YOU CHOOSE?

✔️ Will you walk in the Spirit and resist the enemy?
✔️ Will you use your God-given authority to break strongholds?
✔️ Will you help others experience freedom through Jesus Christ?
🔥 THE CHURCH NEEDS MORE BELIEVERS WHO WALK IN DELIVERANCE—WILL YOU BE ONE OF THEM?

📖 2 Corinthians 10:4 (KJV)
"For the weapons of our warfare are not carnal, but mighty through God to the pulling down of strongholds."
💡 QUESTION: Are you ready to step out in faith and walk in the power of deliverance?

🚨 CHOOSE NOW:
❌ Ignore deliverance and allow the enemy to keep people in bondage.
✔️ Take a stand, walk in power, and set the captives free through Jesus Christ!
🔥 JESUS GAVE US POWER OVER THE ENEMY—IT’S TIME TO USE IT!

⚔️ JOIN THE GOSPEL WARRIORS MOVEMENT!
For more powerful teachings and to connect with fellow warriors, join our Facebook group:
👍 LIKE & FOLLOW MY PAGE FOR EXCLUSIVE TEACHINGS TO BE A TRUE GOSPEL WARRIOR!

PRAYER FOR DELIVERANCE AND SPIRITUAL FREEDOM!
"Heavenly Father, I come before You in the mighty name of Jesus, declaring freedom over my life and over every person reading this. Lord, I renounce every sin, every stronghold, and every chain that the enemy has placed on me. I break every demonic assignment and every generational curse by the blood of Jesus! Holy Spirit, fill me with Your power and guide me into all truth. I choose to walk in freedom, authority, and victory! In Jesus' name, AMEN!"
PROOF, SOURCES & BIBLICAL EVIDENCE – DELIVERANCE IS BIBLICAL!

💭 READER QUESTION:
"Brother John, is there solid biblical proof that deliverance is real and still needed today? Where can I find more evidence?"
🚨 THE TRUTH: EVERYTHING WE TEACH IS ROOTED IN SCRIPTURE & VERIFIED BY HISTORY!

📖 Luke 10:17 (KJV)
"And the seventy returned again with joy, saying, Lord, even the devils are subject unto us through thy name."

✅ BIBLICAL PROOF – DELIVERANCE IS A COMMAND FROM JESUS!
📖 JESUS CAST OUT DEMONS REGULARLY!
✔️ Mark 1:34 (KJV) – "And he healed many that were sick of divers diseases, and cast out many devils."
💡 Lesson: If Jesus made deliverance a priority, why do so many churches ignore it?

📖 THE EARLY CHURCH CONTINUED CASTING OUT DEMONS!
✔️ Acts 16:18 (KJV) – "Paul, being grieved, turned and said to the spirit, I command thee in the name of Jesus Christ to come out of her. And he came out the same hour."
💡 Lesson: Deliverance did not stop with Jesus—it continued with the apostles and should continue today!

📖 DEMONS FEAR THE NAME OF JESUS!
✔️ Mark 9:25 (KJV) – "Thou dumb and deaf spirit, I charge thee, come out of him, and enter no more into him."
💡 Lesson: There is power in the name of Jesus to cast out demons—this power still works today!

✅ HISTORICAL PROOF – DELIVERANCE THROUGHOUT CHURCH HISTORY!
📜 "The Early Church Fathers" – Early Christian leaders documented the reality of deliverance in their writings.
📜 "Foxe’s Book of Martyrs" – John Foxe – Records of believers who fought against demonic strongholds.
📜 "The Welsh Revival (1904-1905)" – A powerful move of God where many were set free from oppression.
